name: engineering-rules
description: The complete engineering law and working method as one progressive-disclosure skill and nine route sub-commands: hard caps and zero-tolerance bans, the file and folder organization law, performance/security/test-scenario/clean-code catalogs, an eight-phase workflow driven by a phase ledger that refuses to advance without its exit artifact, a run discipline (task start, phase boundaries, loop-backs, waiver limits, git safety, a law self-audit), a leftover sweep at every stage end with a dead-code cleanup commit and a reuse search behind every new symbol, a standing agent-tool authorization with four mandatory sends and a ledger that refuses to tick over a skipped one, a senior-PO clarify round with an intent restatement, an end-to-end coverage map and a memory-is-a-hypothesis rule, six question banks, five review checks, the ship gate, a frontend design law with an AI-tell catalog, a design scout and a pre-flight, and twelve ready-made design specs. 122 sections, loaded only when the phase calls for them. /engineering-rules:quick, :full, :shape, :walkthrough, :audit, :triage, :skill, :design and :log pick a route by the user's word, the bare invocation walks the user through the options before anything starts, and an agentless first word keeps every helper shape in the main conversation. Three hooks enforce the law at the tool boundary: an edit guard, a file cap and a re-anchor after compaction; the reviewer, mechanic and builder shapes run on Claude Code's own agent types (fork, Explore, Plan, general-purpose), briefed by the skill, all on the session's model.
